name: Fortune 300 — 2026
description: The first 300 companies in the 2026 U.S. Fortune 500. Includes 266 companies with 269 installable monitors and 34 unavailable companies with explanations. Coverage is bounded and may be division-specific. Select no more than 200 monitors per handoff; use explicit batches.
